metadata.description: Specialized skills and agents for building and deploying integrations across Microsoft Power Platform and the n8n workflow automation ecosystem. Includes Power Platform custom connector authoring, the full n8n agent bundle (workflow building, debugging, Code-node scripting, community-node packaging, and self-hosting), and Dataverse Classic Workflow (WF4/XAML) tooling.

plugins.name: dataverse-classic-workflow
plugins.description: Read, analyze, compare, edit, copy, and publish Microsoft Dataverse Classic Workflows (the WF4/XAML-based `workflow` table — not Power Automate cloud flows). Bundles a top-level orchestrator plus 7 sub-skills and a shared knowledge base.

plugins.name: n8n
plugins.description: Full n8n agent bundle — orchestrator agent plus all five n8n skills (build/debug/code-node/self-host/community-nodes). Drives a continuous-learning loop that captures each session's discoveries back into the skill bundle.

plugins.name: n8n-build-workflow
plugins.description: Design and author n8n workflow JSON — triggers, flow logic (IF/Switch/Merge/Loop), expressions, AI workflows (LangChain cluster nodes), sub-workflows, and the array-of-items data model. Emits import-ready JSON.

plugins.name: n8n-code-node
plugins.description: Write correct JavaScript or Python in the n8n Code node. Covers both run modes, the canonical pairedItem-preserving pattern, binary helpers, Luxon and JMESPath, the Pyodide runtime, and AI Code Tools.

plugins.name: n8n-create-nodes
plugins.description: Build production-ready n8n community nodes as npm packages. Covers declarative (REST API wrapping) and programmatic (custom logic) node styles, credential types, webhook/poll triggers, versioned nodes, and publishing to the n8n community.

plugins.name: n8n-debug-workflow
plugins.description: Diagnose failing n8n executions. Indexed error catalog, item-linking forensics, rate-limit recovery, trigger debugging (Webhook/Schedule/App), and resilience patterns (retryOnFail, continueOnFail, Error Workflows).

plugins.name: n8n-self-host
plugins.description: Install, configure, and operate self-hosted n8n. Day-0 production checklist, Docker Compose (single + queue mode), reverse-proxy configs, Postgres setup and SQLite migration, encryption-key handling, backups, and upgrades.

plugins.name: power-platform-custom-connector
plugins.description: Build Power Platform custom connectors (Independent Publisher and Verified Publisher) ready for Microsoft certification. Covers Swagger 2.0 / OpenAPI definitions, all 5 authentication types, the 13 policy templates, C# custom code (script.csx), webhook triggers, dynamic values/lists, Copilot Studio AI extensions, and the full certification submission workflow.
